name: kurei_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, full body, standing still in a neutral idle pose facing left, all four feet planted flat on the ground, head held level in profile, looking straight ahead to the left in the walking direction. A big, heavy, burly four-legged dragon with a glossy wet clay-like body: shiny teal skin with strong highlights, cream-yellow throat, chest, belly, and underside of the tail. The body build, proportions, legs, belly and tail are exactly like the body reference: a long sturdy body, strong legs with big grey claws, a smooth cream chest and belly, and a thick tail that curves back and down to a wide fin-shaped tip. A fairly small head compared to the body. Blond hair drawn as clean pixel art like the rest of the sprite: a few bold spiky tufts with a solid dark outline and three flat shades of yellow, long bangs that fall forward over the forehead and hang down in front of the eye to the cheek, and a thin mane running down the neck and back; the hair lies flat and is not puffy. Flat salmon-orange markings painted on the skin: triangle patterns on the back and shoulders, short stripes on the snout, cheeks and front legs. Two dark grey horns at the back of the head, a large curved tan-brown horn growing from the side of the head and curving forward over the top of the eye like the brim of a cap, cream furry ears. Large eyes with clearly visible white sclera, yellow iris, black slit pupil with a small white highlight, heavy half-lidded eyes with a mischievous, teasing, scheming look. The head is shaped like the face reference: a flat forehead and a long, flat snout that tapers gently to a smooth rounded tip. The only details on the face are the eye and a long mouth line with a few small, shallow zigzags, curled up at the back corner in a sly, mischievous smirk. Thick glossy drips of teal and cream goo running down the belly, legs and tail tip, with small puddles on the ground. Plain flat background, the dragon alone.
refs: draw the face in the same simple, clean anime style as this drawing - head shape with a flat top and long flat snout, large eyes with clear white sclera, heavy half-lidded mischievous look, light spiky hair; the snout is plain and clean; the head should be drawn a bit smaller relative to the body than here

copy this sprite closely: body, proportions, legs, belly, tail, pose, head shape, horns; the hair in this sprite is badly drawn, so do not copy it - draw new hair as described in the text; make the mouth zigzag smaller and shallower than here
